summary.text: Nik Sandman is a retired farmer and rural mail carrier from Wauneta running as the Libertarian nominee. A registered Democrat until two years before his 2026 run, he says the country needs "redirection" and supports extending Medicare to all Americans and rethinking farm subsidies.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Wauneta High School in 1967 and earned a bachelor's degree in philosophy from the University of Nebraska in 1979.
Worked as a wheat, milo and melon farmer for 26 years and as a rural mail carrier for 15 years.
Says he is a Lutheran who was converted at age 17, studied religious and philosophical thought, and served as a campus minister.
Says he was a lifelong Democrat until switching to the Libertarian Party about two years before running.
Says he is 77 and has been married to Colleen for 45 years; they have three children.
